text: 隆基绿能公告，上半年，国内新增光伏装机阶段性回调，公司实现营业收入270.45亿元，同比下降17.58%。同时，受制于行业供需失衡背景下开工率不足，产品毛利率持续低位，叠加第一季度银价高位推升成本导致的部分集中式订单交付损失，联营企业投资损失及人民币升值带来的汇兑损失等多重影响，报告期内公司实现归属于上市公司股东的净亏损36.84亿元。
text_en: LONGi Green Energy announced that in the first half, domestic new PV installations saw a phased pullback, with revenue of RMB 27.045 billion, down 17.58% year-on-year. Meanwhile, due to low capacity utilization amid industry supply-demand imbalance, gross margins remained low, compounded by delivery losses on some centralized orders from elevated silver prices in Q1, investment losses from associates, and exchange losses from RMB appreciation, the company posted a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.684 billion for the reporting period.
